Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness; to better understand your condition, how many days postpartum are you currently?

Also, have you noticed any foul-smelling vaginal discharge, or any chills and rigors?

text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. Also, have you had any difficulty passing stool or gas?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with possible secondary ileus.

The combination of prolonged labor, uterine tenderness, fever, and decreased bowel sounds strongly suggests an infection of the uterine lining; please hold off on any oral medications until we confirm the infection severity.
